principles.statement: When a new graph node joins the living graph, candidate relationships come from the relationship neighborhood — real edges walked hop by hop — before keyword seeds.
principles.rationale: Live-measured 2026-09-20: over three uncapped runs, ALL qualifying edges originated in the relationship neighborhood (Traverse from the project over parent/child + explicit relations); keyword seeds contributed zero. Graph adjacency is the primary signal; keywords bootstrap the first-ever edge only.

principles.statement: Order candidates by graph proximity (hop distance), then overlap strength — and never cap: the neighborhood walk's depth is the only bound a relevance decision needs.
principles.rationale: Hop-ordered traversal returned 21-23 candidates per run and every one cleared its floor without truncation; caps added earlier were rejected as guesses that hide the workload the metrics exist to measure.

principles.statement: Record HOW each edge was discovered (discovered_via, hop distance) on the edge itself, and put run metrics on the output — future tuning must come from data, not folklore.
principles.rationale: link_metrics (candidate counts, shared-term distribution, edges written, duration) on every CreateGraph output is what later surfaced the keep-alive 80x win honestly.

heuristics.name: Writing any new relationship-discovery path.
heuristics.description: Traverse the relationship neighborhood first (hop-ordered), use keyword search only for graph-distant candidates, set per-scope floors from the relevance policy, and emit full run metrics.

heuristics.name: A relevance or ranking rule is proposed without a metric.
heuristics.description: Ship the metric with the rule; adjust the rule only when a completed uncapped run's numbers argue for it.

decision_rules.condition: A new container joins the graph.
decision_rules.action: Walk its scope's relationship neighborhood at the configured depth; qualify candidates by hop-aware floors; write bidirectional edges with discovered_via and graph_hops provenance; emit link_metrics.
